card.name: Words just before a named exclusion condition
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "with", "of", "unless" or "except" right before a condition or state that is being ruled out or avoided. Mostly in contraindication lists, e.g. "patients with" before a severe disease.

modes.label: Patients with, in exclusions
modes.description: The word "with" after "patients" in contraindication or avoid-use statements, before a named disease.

card.writes: It seems to suppress words meaning "any" or "anywhere" and to promote words like "fully" and "truly", which suits a following qualifier of degree.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before a condition that rules something out, like "patients with" in a contraindication.
